title: Statues — Singles
description: Standalone devotional figures with no series of their own: saints, the Sacred Heart, Our Lady under her various titles, crucifixes. A themed series gets its own set alongside this one.

source.note: Record how each piece's reference came about — generated, photographed, or commissioned.

notes: Unlike a single-origin series, this set can mix origins — note per piece if they differ.
